title: Unsmoked Crumbly Japanese Chicken Oyakodon
description: A smoky and crumbly Japanese dish featuring chicken and orange juice, originating from the Tohoku region, this oyakodon is a show-off dish that is onion and garlic free.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, dashi broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sake.
Add the chicken to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook until browned and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the eggs over the cooked chicken and scramble the eggs until they are almost set.
Add the smoked paprika to the eggs and chicken, and stir to combine.
To assemble the oyakodon, place a scoop of Japanese rice in a bowl, followed by the chicken and egg mixture.
Pour some of the remaining marinade over the top of the dish and serve immediately.
